data.exact_reserve_text: Net prior year reserves on US casualty business were strengthened during 2023, a common trend seen across the market. A detailed review by line of business has been performed, resulting in an explicit uplift to claims reserves of GBP 2.2m.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross strengthening of GBP 2.2 million in prior year reserves, representing approximately 4.0% of its opening gross claims outstanding. This strengthening was primarily driven by an explicit uplift to claims reserves following a detailed review by line of business, and adverse development on US casualty business. The syndicate noted that this strengthening was influenced by elevated levels of economic and social inflation observed in major economies during 2023 and 2022, which impacted claims costs, particularly for long-term liabilities like Periodic Payment Orders.

data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development figure of GBP 2.2m is an "explicit uplift to claims reserves" and is inferred to be a gross prior year strengthening, supported by narrative mentioning "net prior year reserves... strengthened". It is not explicitly labelled as "gross prior year development". The claims development triangle on page 13 is unusual, showing 2023, 2019, 2018, 2017 underwriting years, with 2022 mentioned as being "on a look through basis" but not present as a column.
